lane_status._doc: WP-4's frozen null gate returned a FAIL: 7,489 signals across 9 symbols on the 5-minute timebase with full context parity, failing the random-entry null at every horizon (hit rate 49.1-49.4%, 2 of 9 symbols positive). The trigger is a VOLATILITY detector, not a direction detector -- an outcome the pre-registration named in advance and pre-committed to rejecting. WP-5 (paper orders) did not proceed; it was absolutely gated on a Stage-A pass.
lane_status._reviving_this_lane_requires: A NEW signal and a NEW pre-registration. Explicitly NOT a threshold sweep, NOT 'try more names', NOT a re-slice of this data -- all three are kill-listed as dead-knobs dressed as progress, and the prereg pre-committed that a null STOPS the lane. The replay+null harness (backtest/tools/multi_intraday_null_harness.py) is retained and adjudicates any future candidate in one session.

_doc: MULTI-SYMBOL OPTIONS LANE (arm multi-1). A COPY of the SPY engine, symbol-parameterized. J directive 2026-08-19: copy the SPY engine, do not touch the original, trade many names. NOTHING here is SPY-hardcoded. TRACKED config; live state beside it is gitignored.
_separation: This lane NEVER imports, modifies, or shares state with the SPY engine. Its P&L is never SPY evidence and vice versa (crypto-twin non-comparability doctrine).

mode.name: intraday_v1
mode._doc: WHAT BUSINESS THIS LANE IS IN. J directive 2026-08-19/20: replicate the engine that has recent green evidence -- the INTRADAY SPY machine -- on more names. The multi-day model this lane originally carried was inherited from the weekly lane, whose signal died a five-cut null-gate death (WEEKLY-EXPIRY-EXPERIMENT-2026-08-18.md). Multi-day is not forbidden forever; it is DORMANT until intraday replication has evidence. See _dormant_multiday below -- kept, not deleted, so reviving it is a config change not an archaeology project.
mode._time_stop_doc: Mirrors the SPY engine's own hard time-stop. The expiry-day flatten schedule (flatten_schedule_et 14:45/14:50/14:55) still takes precedence when the position's contract expires TODAY -- that is a safety cutoff, not a profit rule, and it fires first.

account._key_source_doc: Reads the EXISTING key from automation/state/crypto-twin/secrets.json (accounts.twin) by REFERENCE -- the secret is never copied into a second file, so a rotation updates in one place. J directed reuse of this account 2026-08-19 (highest paper balance, $9,628.45, options level 3).
account._shared_account_caveat: This account also runs the crypto twin (BTC/USD, 1/min). Flat-checks and position filters in this lane MUST scope to equity-option symbols only and never touch or count crypto positions -- and the twin's own crypto flat-check must never see these options. Equity-curve P&L on this account is therefore a BLEND of two programs: read per-program ledgers, never the account equity line, for either program's evidence.
account.starting_equity_note: 9628.45 observed 2026-08-19; the crypto twin's dust BTC position (~$0.0002) is immaterial.

universe._doc: A BROAD optionable universe. Membership is NOT a promise of tradeability -- every name passes a LIVE liquidity gate at decision time (see entry.liquidity_gate). J directive: 'more names than I just said... we can trade a lot of different names.'
universe._selection_basis: Liquid US optionable names across sectors: mega-cap tech, semis, index/sector ETFs, financials, energy, healthcare, consumer, high-beta retail favourites. Screened live before any entry.
universe._total_note: ~70 names. The live liquidity gate is what decides what is actually tradeable on any given day -- an event can make a normally-illiquid chain deeply liquid (MRNA 2026-08-19: 1 contract Monday, 30,314 Wednesday).

liquidity_gate._doc: Checked LIVE at decision time, per symbol, per contract -- never from a static universe list. This is the fix for the static-screen failure: catalyst days create their own liquidity.
liquidity_gate._feed_note: No OPRA agreement on this account: every spread number is from the free indicative feed. Permanent disclosure on every row.

_dormant_multiday._why_dormant: multi-day hold model; revive only with intraday evidence in hand

entry._expiry_doc: INTRADAY: take the nearest LISTED expiry (0-3 DTE typical). Still read from the live chain, never a computed calendar -- an expiry can be absent because earnings land that day (verified: NVDA had no 2026-08-26 listing).

risk._cap_note: Lower than the SPY lane's 30% because this lane spreads across many names; per-trade cap x max_concurrent must stay well inside equity.

exits._doc: Starting values ported from the SPY engine's shapes. They were fitted on SPY 0DTE fills and are NOT validated on these underlyings or these DTEs. Paired shadow-clock logs the ported shape alongside any variant from the first signal.

theta_budget.thesis_progress_definition: underlying has moved >= 0.5 * ATR(14) in the trade's direction from entry

_dormant_multiday._why_dormant: same-day exits under intraday_v1; days-to-live is meaningless intraday

exits._mode_note: Under mode.intraday_v1 the exit ladder is: expiry-day flatten (safety, first) -> theta budget (BEFORE the catastrophe cap) -> same-day time stop -> TP1/runner/trail -> catastrophe cap. days_to_live and the weekend guard are dormant, not deleted.

flatten_schedule_et._doc: Expiration-day cutoffs. Alpaca rejects option orders after ~3:15pm ET on expiration day for most names and the do-not-exercise cutoff is 3:00pm ET. A long option left to auto-exercise would deliver shares this account cannot afford.

scanners._doc: Free Alpaca surfaces, all verified working 2026-08-19. These SELECT candidates; they never place or gate a trade on their own.
scanners._verified: movers returned MRNA +177.0% on 2026-08-19, matching the independently derived figure exactly.

promotion._doc: Same bar as every other arm. No result is described as promising until it beats the randomized-entry null at its MAX.
